text:
Olivia (Finance): Heads-up: rolling out a set of billing/quota changes on 2026-05-01. Summary: account-level 72-hour overage grace, a short promotional overage waiver for new signups, modest free-tier rate bumps, and a shorter lifetime for new promo credits. Full notes below.

Marco (Billing Ops): Whats the signup waiver?

Olivia (Finance): Signup waiver = for accounts created after 2026-05-01, the first overage within the first 30 days is waived entirely (we still surface usage). This is separate from the 72h grace that applies to all metered accounts.

Hannah (Support): How will this look on invoices and in the Console?

finance-bot: Example invoice snippet well add: 
```
Usage: 2,300,000 tokens
Grace protection: -25,000 tokens (applied during 72h grace window)
Signup overage waiver: -5,000 tokens (one-time promotional waiver)
Billed usage: 2,270,000 tokens
```

Keisha (Legal): Reminder: waivers and grace are billing conveniences; contractual terms unchanged. Were adding a short FAQ section on exceptions (marketplace accounts, delinquent balances, fraud flags).

Dev-Platform: API/webhook hooks? Partners need a stable contract.

Olivia (Finance): We'll publish a minor OpenAPI bump with two new fields: header X-RW-Grace-Until (ISO ts) and webhook field usage.grace_expires_at. Also add usage.meta.signup_waiver=true for qualifying accounts. Backwards compatible.

Marco (Billing Ops): Free-tier rate limits numbers?

Olivia (Finance): Free-tier requests/sec: text endpoints 3 -> 6 rps, embeddings 1 -> 3 rps. Were increasing to reduce client-side retry noise. Paid and Dedicated customers unchanged.

Hannah (Support): Promo credit expiry? Several customers asked about this.

Olivia (Finance): Promo credits issued after cutover will expire after 120 days (was 365). Any credits issued prior to the change keep their original expiry. Expiry date will be surfaced in Console and in the credits API.

Keisha (Legal): Also note we reserve the right to deny signup waivers for accounts created via certain channels (resellers/marketplaces) per our terms. TOS language updated in draft.

Marco (Billing Ops): Rollout timeline: internal docs + API spec change tomorrow, Console UX updates in 10 days, emails to impacted customers 7 days before 2026-05-01, and a short recorded briefing for Support and Sales.

Hannah (Support): Ill update KB, canned messages, and add a troubleshooting checklist for grace-related disputes. Will link the KB here when done.

Olivia (Finance): Thanks. Please review the draft FAQ: https://redwood.internal/billing/may-2026-waiver-and-grace (comments by EOD Wed). Ping me for any wording that might be customer-facing confusing. :thumbsup:
